steps.text: A polynomial has no division, roots or logarithm of the variable, so every real x can be substituted.
The domain is all real numbers: option A.
The parabola opens downward because a = −1 < 0, so the vertex is a maximum.
The range is all y at or below the maximum: option C.
Axis of symmetry x = −b/(2a) with a = 1, b = 6.
The parabola opens upward and its lowest point (vertex) is labelled (−1, 2).
The smallest y-value is 2 and the graph goes up forever.
The range is y ≥ 2: option C.
Axis of symmetry x = −b/(2a) with a = 2, b = −8.
a = 2 > 0, so the vertex is a minimum. Find f(2).
Axis x = 2 and minimum −5: option A.
Axis of symmetry x = −b/(2a) with a = 3, b = 6.
The y-intercept is f(0) (the constant term).
Axis x = −1 and y-intercept −4: option C.
